description: Tree species groups read on the SCNU 360 VR tour (vr.scnu.ac.kr/360vr, visual reference only; nothing copied or linked) where one species fills a row or stand. A crown inside a polygon takes its species unless its own VR colour class is listed in exceptVr (VG01: the plaza also holds green broadleaf trees and dark pines, VR scene_e1 r). Polygons traced on the NGII 2025 orthophoto around the trees the VR scenes show (estimated, 추정). maxHeightM: a crown with a CHMv2 height above it keeps its own reading. Read by scripts/campus-model/fetch/treeInventory.mjs.

groups.source: VR scene_c1 r, b, l and scene_e1 r: two rows of metasequoia (narrow yellow-orange conical crowns) along the central plaza and its pond, from C1 to the roundabout; pines on the slopes beside them stay pines
VR scene_c2 l, r and scene_c3 f, r: metasequoia stand between C3 and C2 and along the C2 access road
VR scene_c3 l: metasequoia row west of C3
VR scene_d1 l: metasequoia row along the curved road south-west of D1
NGII 2025 orthophoto (d4-block, west slope): rough low scrub and grass, no closed crowns; crowns there without a CHMv2 height over 5 m are drawn as low shrub mass, taller CHMv2 crowns stay trees
D-24; refs/h-scnu-vr/d4_l_d4_south_pines_path.jpg; SYNTHESIS section 9 Korean red pines along east/south edge, bounded to junction planting strip (estimated)

curatedInventory.source: D-24/D-34; NGII parcel boundaries and VR scene_d4; replay after treeInventory automatic extraction and VR fitting (estimated)
curatedInventory.matching: Authoritative scoped inventory: after automatic extraction and VR fitting, replace only trees inside bbox with replacementTrees. records are the before/after audit, not nearest-neighbour matching instructions.
